title: Veggie Sausage-Gnocchi Skillet with Peppers, Mushrooms & Sauerkraut

steps.text: Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Place in a medium bowl.
Once the water in the pot is boiling, add gnocchi and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until gnocchi begins to float to the surface, about 3 minutes. Drain in a colander and set aside.
While the gnocchi are cooking, wash, dry, trim, and seed bell pepper; medium dice. Add bell pepper and mushrooms to the bowl with the onion.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, slice sausages into ½-inch-thick rounds.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, sausage, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies soften and sausage is warmed through, 4-5 minutes. (Or cook sausage according to package instructions.)
Meanwhile, drain sauerkraut in a colander to remove excess liquid.

When the veggies and sausage are done, add cooked gnocchi and sauerkraut to the skillet; stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until gnocchi are warmed through, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide gnocchi, sausage, and veggies between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
